text:
harry (sales): Quick ask: OptiMed Labs requesting a 6-week pilot with a 58% discount on hosted inference to validate clinical summarization. They say nationwide pilot afterwards. Can finance approve? :eyes:
megan (finance): Need $ numbers, proposed billing (credit vs invoice), and any PHI risk. Also whether they want retroactive conversion credit.
harry (sales): Estimate: 2.0M tokens + some embeddings; list ~ $60k. At 58% they'd pay ~$25.2k; concession ~$34.8k. No retro credit requested yet. Customer will sign LOI if we confirm margin.
oliver (revops): Recommend treating as marketing concession GL=5405, set hard pilot credit cap = $35k, and require a non-refundable onboarding fee $2k. Also require LOI with decision date and conversion KPI.
sylvia (head of finance): Policy: approvals >50% require VP review. We can provisionally approve up to 50% with conditions: LOI, Deal Desk ticket, SOW limiting scope, onboarding fee, and GL code confirmation. Anything >50% needs VP signoff.
claire (legal): If there's PHI, need BAA and data flow. We'll review SOW in 48hrs once uploaded. Add liability cap for pilot.
harry (sales): OK — counterproposal to customer: 50% off + $2k onboarding + $35k cap, LOI required. Will ask customer to sign LOI. Tagging @deal-bot to create entry.
deal-bot: /dealdesk create customer=OptiMedLabs pilot_discount=50% pilot_cap=35000 onboarding_fee=2000 expected_ARR=150000 notes="clinical summarization POC, may involve PHI"
megan (finance): Checklist: deal desk URL, LOI pdf, SOW, GL code. We'll finalize concession memo after docs.
sylvia (head of finance): If VP approves >50%, include expected ARR uplift, conversion probability, and exec sponsor in the ticket. Otherwise proceed with 50% conditional.
harry (sales): Thanks — I'll upload LOI and SOW today and loop back.
